runners.updateFailedHint: The previous state still applies — try again in a moment.

register.title: Register runner
register.description: A machine that carries out runs.
register.name: Name
register.kindHelp: Display only — how it works is the machine's own decision.
register.tokenText: Copy it into the machine's configuration. Only its fingerprint is stored; there is no way to show it again.
register.failedHint: Your name is still in the field — try again in a moment.

runs.title: Recent runs
runs.empty: Open a ticket and start a run there — it shows up here afterwards.

form.repoHelp: Only the key travels — which folder is behind it, the machine knows.
form.budgetHelp: Leave empty = the machine uses its own cap.
form.testsHelp: Only commands this machine has approved for this project. They run in the worktree after the work.
form.interactiveHelp: The machine opens a terminal window and runs Claude Code in the foreground — you watch and approve every step.
form.interactiveRemote: Only on a local machine — a remote machine cannot open a window.
form.untrustedText: This ticket’s origin is not “written by the operator”. That is why only the two careful ways of working are offered and no test commands — the server decides this, not this form.
form.noRunnersText: A run needs a machine to pick it up. Register one first.

form.testsUntrusted: An unverified job gets no test commands.
